title: Document the harness reliability behaviours
goal: The harness gained several reliability behaviours in one session: acceptance precheck (close a task whose acceptance already passes), zero-test refusal, command deadline with tree kill, refusal of harness subcommands from worker commands, release of the claim when a mission fails, stale worktree cleanup before start, shared target linking, and prescriptive write-first prompts. Document them in docs/harness.md with a short section each so an operator can predict what a mission will do.
